svg.title: How the upstream checks work
svg.desc: The workflow Upstream runs two checks of what the extension relies on but doesn't control. Every morning, autodarts-contract takes the expected values from src/autodarts.ts and asks the real Autodarts with made-up data only, about a dozen requests: it looks for the key of the session, the sign-in service and the client in the code of play.autodarts.com, script by script until it has found all three, follows the forward of play.autodarts.io, and sends a made-up token, a made-up account and the end of a made-up session to the sign-in service, through the functions of the extension. Every Monday, chrome-beta downloads Chrome for Testing Beta, the next version of Chrome, and runs the end-to-end tests in it against the fake Autodarts. When either fails, its summary names what changed and where the code relies on it, and the bot-health bot opens an issue with the label bot-failure, which the next run that passes closes.
